directory.description: Target Git repository (absolute or relative path)

base.description: Base branch (default: the develop_branch of the repository in its project config)

path.description: Where to create the worktree (default: <project_root>/<auto-numbered>/<repository name>)

allow_existing_branch.description: Allow reusing an existing branch even if its upstream differs from develop_branch

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

name.description: Name of the worktree (the wtN it was numbered as)

branch.description: Branch checked out in the worktree

base.description: Base branch the worktree branch starts from

setupFailed.description: true when the setup command failed or timed out, false when it succeeded or was not run

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
